sentences.en: Have you visited the town where your father was born?
sentences.zh: 你有没有去过你父亲出生的那个镇子？

sentences.en: He is as rich as any man in this town.
sentences.zh: 他和这个镇子里任何一个人一样富有。

sentences.en: If you ever come to town, come to see me.
sentences.zh: 如果你来城里玩，记得来看我。

senses.zh: 镇，小城镇；城镇的居民；（某人常去的）城镇，城里；（与乡村相对的）城镇
